events.description: Monica Geller asks what current action Rachel Green is doing outside.
Monica Geller says the weather outside is currently freezing.
Monica Geller asks Rachel Green to come back inside now.
Rachel Green says Monica Geller previously wanted Rachel Green to take the decorations down.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is currently taking the decorations down.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is okay right now.
Rachel Green asks Mr. Heckles to help Rachel Green.
Mr. Heckles tells Rachel Green to see that this situation proves Mr. Heckles’s point.
Mr. Heckles says this situation with Rachel Green outside taking the decorations down is exactly the kind of thing Mr. Heckles had been talking about.
Mr. Heckles says Mr. Heckles had previously talked about this kind of situation.
